permissions.label: Write and edit their posts
permissions.description: Create new posts, add media, and edit any post assigned to them

permissions.label: Edit others' post
permissions.description: Edit any post, whoever it is assigned to - even in Client Review or Scheduled

permissions.label: Delete own posts
permissions.description: Permanently delete posts they created themselves

permissions.label: Delete others' posts
permissions.description: Permanently delete posts created by anyone on the team

groups.label: Approvals & publishing
groups.description: Reviewing posts and sending them live

permissions.label: Approve / reject
permissions.description: Approve a post or send it back with changes. Needs a review stage in your workflow.

permissions.label: Publish or schedule
permissions.description: Publish now, and set or change any post's schedule at any stage

groups.label: Social profiles
groups.description: Managing social accounts. Off hides this page from their sidebar.

permissions.label: Add a social account
permissions.description: Authorize and connect new social profiles to workspaces they have access to

permissions.label: Delete a social account
permissions.description: Remove a connected profile from workspaces they have access to

permissions.label: Edit social account settings
permissions.description: Edit settings like time zone, watermark, display name, and posting defaults

groups.label: Content library
groups.description: Saved media and posting schedules. Off hides this page from their sidebar.

permissions.label: Manage content
permissions.description: Allows the user to add, edit, and manage content in the Library.

permissions.label: Manage timeslots
permissions.description: Create, edit or delete timeslots from a library

permissions.label: Delete content
permissions.description: Permanently remove media and saved items from the library

groups.label: Inbox
groups.description: Comments and direct messages. Off hides this page from their sidebar.

permissions.label: Reply to DMs & comments
permissions.description: Reply from the unified inbox. Without this, it stays read-only.

permissions.label: Assign messages
permissions.description: Assign conversations to teammates and mark them done

groups.label: Reports & analytics
groups.description: Performance reports and analytics. Off hides this page from their sidebar.

permissions.label: Export & share reports
permissions.description: Download reports as PDF or send them directly via email to clients

groups.label: DM automations
groups.description: Automated replies and DM flows. Off hides this page from their sidebar.

permissions.label: Create an automation
permissions.description: Build new DM automations, triggers, and auto-reply flows

permissions.label: Edit / delete automation
permissions.description: Edit or permanently delete existing DM automations

groups.label: Paid ads
groups.description: Paid ad campaigns. Off hides this page from their sidebar.

permissions.label: Boost a post
permissions.description: Boost an existing published post as a paid promotion from connected ad accounts

groups.label: Client review
groups.description: Sharing posts with clients for sign-off before they go live. Needs a client review stage in your workflow.

permissions.label: Send posts to clients
permissions.description: Share posts on the client calendar for approval, urgent ones too

permissions.label: Approve for the client
permissions.description: Approve on the client's behalf when they haven't responded - always logged

permissions.label: Workspace settings
permissions.description: Edit settings of workspaces they have access to - name, social profiles, watermark, etc.

permissions.label: Invite members
permissions.description: Invite people to workspaces they have access to and assign them a role

permissions.label: Remove members
permissions.description: Remove people from workspaces they have access to
